title: 边在IBM上班边做AI副业，月入6万
title_en: Working at IBM While Building AI Side Hustle, $60K/Month
title_jp: IBM勤務の傍らAI副業、月収6万ドル
title_ar: يعمل في IBM ويبني عملا جانبيا بـ AI، 60 ألف دولار شهريا

{"ops": [{"insert": "边在IBM上班边做AI副业，月入6万"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从失败的交易工具到房地产AI，她找到了成功公式", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Paline Clavelloux白天在IBM上班，晚上做自己的AI副业。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一个项目是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "COVID期间，想搞automated trading，contact了一个在IT工作的朋友。一起做了个prototype，24/7交易，return超过5倍initial investment。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "尝试monetize——给traders提供customizable alerts。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "结果是0销量。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "花了几个月try get customers，但sold zero alerts。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Wish早知道build community和validate ideas with potential users before diving deep into product development的重要性。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你需要为能reach的audiences build！", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stop了trading project，move on到其他SaaS项目，确保不repeat same mistakes。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在main project是IACrea——real estate SaaS，seconds内stage house photos。帮人们faster sell homes，让buyer visualize有家具的rooms。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "目前月入8000欧元（约6万人民币）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Idea来自一个relative trouble visualizing room，realized自己good enough with AI和image processing to solve problem。Also thought able to reach large market。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "赚钱模式：subscriptions + credits。Credits允许enhance photos without subscription。Unit price比subscription高，但some users prefer it。所以choose both——fit client preferences。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "MVP用NextJS + Typescript + Supabase build。NextJS遇到issues，边build边学，但mentor helped。Really recommend finding mentors，made better developer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "MVP完成后，通过attending real estate events、hanging out in forums，从specialized real estate groups获得feedback。甚至organized webinars。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Product很basic。只有一个feature：Renovate room。还很buggy。If no one interested，prepared move on到next project，as always do。但人们found it useful。Soon开始paying for service。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "First payment的感觉无法describe，awesome。That’s when considered idea validated。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "几个月后，tech cofounder joined venture。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "直到几周前，IACrea还是side project，同时full time在IBM工作。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Product successful，但subtract taxes和partner's share后，没剩多少。Financially more secure to keep job。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Now，full-time indie hacker，有新SaaS in the works，hope to launch soon。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有NextJSDirectory——NextJS boilerplate for building directory websites in minutes。Directories是aggregate niche resources的websites，通过affiliation和sponsoring赚passive income。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "One-time payment出售。一个月前launch，赚了800美元。Fun fact：demo directory里放了affiliate links——alone赚了约60欧元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最近stop working on APIForAI因为failed。有一些customers但不够keep spending time。Considering selling，但haven't taken time list it。Interested的话let me know。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Also worth mentioning去年built unrealme.io，三个月后sold。Sold时没有MRR，三个月赚了约500美元，four figures卖在Microns。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "作为indie hacker最significant breakthrough之一来自leveraging Twitter。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Started tweeting daily about data science、entrepreneurship、SaaS。Share successes、failures、story。Consistently doing this gradually increased follower count（18k+）和engagement。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Audience不really overlap with IACrea target customer，所以don't get many sales directly from followers。但does overlap with一些newer projects。And helps in other ways too。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Allow people know——hopefully refer people到IACrea when relevant。Many share link on social media，giving backlinks for SEO。Get support when have questions about tech、SEO、strategy等。Help find business opportunities和top talent。例如，需要find freelancer时，got 300 applications in DMs。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "X上grow personal brand的tips："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "If want build online presence，don't do it with product。Do it as person。People love hear其他人的stories。Plus，exit business时，still have audience。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Remember if give，people will give back。Provide value consistently。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Building audience开始difficult。至少对她was。But worth it。To stay motivated，tried @tibo_maker的"100 tweeting days challenge"，recommend it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lastly，remember building brand doesn't mean sharing every personal detail about yourself。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "七、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "NextJSDirectory的audience aligns with target customer，所以relying on social media。Tweet about it，retweet people who make money from directories as social proof，announce launches。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Later会shift focus到SEO，让people outside circle能找到。Tried ads but didn't work。Lots to learn about converting with ads。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Beyond social media promoting，marketing一直很challenging。Never trained in it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Mostly grew IACrea by leveraging communities who spread the word。About 30% revenue来自these communities。Simply answered related to virtual staging的问题，posted about product new improvements。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Also partnered with不sell houses的real estate professionals——photographers、coaches等。About 20% revenue来自these partnerships。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And，after converting customer，made sure churn was low by offering higher quality product、developing users requested features。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Considered investing in influencer marketing，但never found any influencers for real estate agents。有real estate influencers展示fancy houses，但audience是individuals；not agents。Important——influencer's audience needs匹配target customer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "八、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "关于专注一个行业vs探索多个行业："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stick to one niche——know well的niche——是好主意。Accelerator。Can capitalize on knowledge和audience。Traffic too，if link products to each other。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但她didn't do that。Not specialized in particular industry。Main SaaS focused on real estate，started时no real estate experience。Big disadvantage at first。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And lately，been focusing on other niches。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "For her，it's working。If not expert in any particular industry，think helpful to explore、see where most comfortable。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Plan keep growing IACrea，by expanding into new markets。Keep exploring other industries with other projects too。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "九、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "给newcomers的建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Don't overthink。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " Almost didn't start因为in head about what kind of business entity start、what laws didn't know about。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Don't be afraid of competition。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " Competition是好signal。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stay consistent。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stay confident。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Remember first projects usually fail", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " but learn from failure、have assets can use to launch faster in future。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Paline的故事是side hustler的典型——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Full-time corporate job，nights和weekends做indie hacking。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "First project failed（0 sales），但learned valuable lesson：build for audiences you can reach。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "IACrea从personal problem（relative couldn't visualize room）开始，现在月入8000欧元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Key insights——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Mentors matter", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Personal brand helps even if not directly related to product", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Community marketing（30% revenue）和partnerships（20% revenue）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Don't overthink，just start", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "First projects fail but provide learning", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最重要的是，"}, {"insert": "she kept going。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " Even with full-time job。Even after failure。That persistence paid off。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: Working at IBM while doing AI side hustle sixty thousand monthly. From failed trading tool to real estate AI she found success formula. Paline Clavelloux works at IBM daytime works on AI side project at night. First project what. During COVID wanted to do automated trading contacted friend who worked in IT. Together made prototype 24/7 trading return exceeded five times initial investment. Tried to monetize provide customizable alerts for traders. Result was zero sales. Spent months trying get customers sold zero alerts. Wish knew earlier importance of building community and validating ideas with potential users before diving deep into product development. Need to build for audiences you can reach. Stopped trading project moved on to other SaaS projects ensure not repeat same mistakes. Now.
